findings.reason: without a positive control that a combined heading+declaration write is accepted, §5's own measure cannot distinguish a correct implementation from the `source_text`-based one its amendment exists to forbid.
findings.text: §5's amended deliverable (line 125) requires the widened coverage check to read the declarations the write produces, precisely so a write that adds a heading and its declaration together is not falsely refused, but the done-when tests only an undeclared heading (refused) and a declaration with no heading (refused); neither test exercises the acceptance path, so a guard built on the existing `source_text` site passes §5's gate while refusing the normal `insert_section` route (reckon/_store.py:3014-3028 adds the heading and its declaration in one write).

rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §5's done-when (docs/plans/a-plan-is-done-when-every-section-is-ticked.html:128) tests only the two refusal directions, not the acceptance of a write that adds a heading and its declaration together, which is the case the amended deliverable names.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the census is directed to the evidence record; no scratchpad or node-local temporary path is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — `section-without-todo` and `todo-without-section` are emitted audit codes rather than code symbols, and no plan label, ticket number or changelog prose enters §5.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the amended mechanism is correct and its caller is named: the existing coverage check reads `source_text` at reckon/_store.py:1382 before `write_state` renders `plan-section-declarations`, so a combined heading+declaration write would be refused against the old declarations, and running the check on the rendered HTML fixes it.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §5 carries one control (one coverage check over headings↔declarations, surfaced as audit codes, is the same thing project).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the sections declare no depends-on/informs/gates relations (all `data-links=""`), so no relationship points at a wrong node; the §5 build order (§3 → §6 → §5) is carried in the open followup f-tick-005, not in a miswired link.
